name: io.github.Dynobase/dynobase-mcp
title: Dynobase
description: Query DynamoDB from AI tools through the Dynobase desktop app. Read-only unless you allow writes.

environmentVariables.name: DYNOBASE_MCP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token from Dynobase → Settings → AI → MCP server. Optional: read from Dynobase's settings when unset.

environmentVariables.name: DYNOBASE_MCP_URL
environmentVariables.description: MCP endpoint. Optional: defaults to http://127.0.0.1:<port>/mcp with the port saved in Dynobase.
